system.description: The most common form of powered armor surviving after the collapse of the Mandate. Voraciously power-hungry, requiring a Type B power cell for 24 hours of operation, but provides encrypted military comms, vacc suit functionality, low-light and infrared visuals, and an energy feed port. Renders the wearer immune to harm from unarmed attacks, grenades, or weapons of TL3 or lower. Obvious. Sealed-suit armor, unusable by wearers without a basically human body plan. Not normally available for sale.
